Transform your creative ideas into original songs with Auria, the AI-powered music generation app that turns simple text into fully-produced tracks. Whether you're a songwriter exploring new melodies, a content creator needing custom soundtracks, or a music enthusiast bringing your musical vision to life, Auria delivers professional-quality audio—fast and effortlessly.

WHY AURIA?

Intelligent AI Music Generation  
Type a style description and your lyrics—Auria's advanced AI creates complete, high-quality music tracks in seconds.

10+ Preset Musical Styles  
Instantly explore Upbeat Pop, Chill Lo-Fi, Indie Folk, Epic Cinematic, Electronic Dance, Smooth Jazz, Acoustic Ballad, Hip-Hop Beat, Ambient Meditation, Rock Anthem and more. Each preset captures authentic genre characteristics and production quality.

Custom Style Descriptions  
Go beyond presets—describe any combination of genre, mood, and instrumentation. From "jazzy chords with vinyl crackle" to "orchestral epic with emotional crescendo," Auria interprets your creative vision.

Lyrics-to-Music Conversion   
Enter your own lyrics and watch Auria craft melodies, harmonies, and arrangements that bring your words to life. Every song is unique and tailored to your input.

Quick Tag Builder  
Speed up creation with instant genre and mood tags. Tap to add Pop, Rock, Jazz, Energetic, Melancholic or dozens of other descriptors—then combine them for unlimited musical possibilities.

Top AI Models  
Choose from cutting-edge music AI models, each optimized for different styles and quality levels. Preview credit costs upfront and select the perfect balance of speed and sonic detail.

Real-Time Audio Playback  
Every generated track features an animated waveform player with precise time tracking. Play, pause and scrub through your music instantly—no waiting for downloads.

Personal Audio Gallery  
All compositions save automatically to your in-app gallery. Browse your entire music library, replay favorites and track how many original songs you've created.

Smart Credit System  
Generate music using a transparent credit system. Each model displays its credit cost before generation, and you'll always know your remaining balance at a glance.

One-Tap Download & Share  
Love what you made? Download high-quality audio files straight to your device for sharing with friends, posting to social media or using in your creative projects.

Live Generation Feedback  
Watch your track move from queued to processing to complete with status updates and haptic notifications. Generation typically takes 1–3 minutes.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Describe your desired music style—pick a preset or write your own.  
2. Add your lyrics (required) to give your song words and meaning.  
3. Choose an AI model based on credit cost and style preference.  
4. Tap Generate and let Auria compose your original track.  
5. Listen, save or download—then create your next masterpiece!

WHO AURIA IS FOR
• Songwriters testing melodies and lyric phrings before recording  
• Content creators needing royalty-concern-free background music  
• Musicians exploring new genres and production styles with AI  
• Podcasters and video editors looking for custom intro/outro tracks  
• Anyone who loves experimenting with music creation powered by AI

SUBSCRIPTIONS & CREDITS
Auria operates on a flexible credit system: each generation uses credits based on the AI model and features you select. Credits are available through one-off packs or optional auto-renewing plans. Pricing, terms and conditions are clearly presented in-app.

Note: An internet connection is required for music generation and downloading. Results are AI-generated audio; always respect copyright and licensing if using tracks commercially.

Download Auria today and turn every lyric, every idea, every creative spark into a fully-produced song—powered by AI, inspired by you!

record.description_evidence:
djAI: Create AI Music & AI Songs!

Welcome to djAI, the revolutionary app that lets you create stunning AI music and generate unique AI songs in no time! Whether Pop, Rock, Rap, or Techno – djAI is your ultimate AI music generator for every genre. Bring your musical ideas to life with Artificial Intelligence!

What to expect:

 • Genre Diversity: Choose from genres like Pop, Rock, Rap, Electronic, Jazz, R&B, Metal, or Country to create your perfect AI music.
 • Clone your own voice and create songs with it
 • Choose between three different AI studios for maximum variety in your songs
 • Choose from a variety of songwriters for completely different lyric styles
 • Mood & Style: Set the vibe of your AI songs with options like Happy, Melancholic, Energetic, Calm, or Romantic. Refine the style with Instrumental, Acoustic, Synthetic, or Orchestral.
 • Vocal Options: Choose between male and female vocals to give your AI tracks a personal touch.
 • Intuitive Design: djAI impresses with a cool and user-friendly design that seamlessly guides you through the AI music production process.
 • Your Collection: Save and manage your created AI songs in your personal library.
 • Extend songs with additional minutes of music
 • Try for Free: Create one AI song for free every week. Additional AI music can easily be added.
 • Make Music: Make the music you've always wanted to create right now!

Making music with AI has never been easier! With djAI, you don't need any prior musical knowledge. The perfect app for anyone who wants to create AI music and generate unique AI songs.
